design.decision: Bid every trick you can make and stop there. A set loses the whole bonus.
design.opponent: Shown on the first made contract. Opponents learn that setting this team removes its multiplier.
design.rationale: This is the safe twin of cb-contract-mult: half the amount, paid only on a make. Simulation shows whether a safe or risky contract-scaled multiplier plays better at common. The added make condition is the 'require the contract' half of the bid-tension target.
design.draftText: +1 contract multiplier for each trick in your team's contract if your team makes its contract

critic.concerns: Scaling plus a make condition; overlaps cb-contract-mult and cb-make-mult.
